extracted_signals.author: Kane Shieh, TradingPub
extracted_signals.verification_note: The vendor reports live alerts from 08/23/24-3/28/26 and a 54-14 record, but does not publish an independently auditable alert/fill ledger or the proprietary pin formula.

extracted_signals.author: Days to Expiry
extracted_signals.rule_summary: 3 mechanical setups: (a) 9:35 iron condor +/-0.75%, 50%TP or 2x stop, close by 2pm; (b) post-catalyst ATM straddle sell, 2x credit stop, 1-4h hold; (c) failed-move S/R reversal vertical, volume-confirmed rejection wick + 2 consec closes above level
extracted_signals.gap: no 3-setup 0DTE playbook scanner; individual pieces scattered

extracted_signals.author: Brendan Kafka
extracted_signals.rule_summary: 0DTE SPY call/put on 5m chart: first 1-3 candles establish bias; entry above opening wick low (support); stop 20% option risk below S/R; target = prior-session wick high; indicators VWAP + 9EMA + volume + ATR + RSI
extracted_signals.gap: flip_bot trades equities/futures, not 0DTE options; combined VWAP+9EMA+opening-wick-support gate not explicit

extracted_signals.author: Ross Cameron (Warrior Trading)
extracted_signals.rule_summary: Pre-market gapper universe (>4-5% gap, high RV, small float); 1-min ORB (first 9:30-9:31 candle); entry above first candle high; stop below first candle low; 2:1 to 3:1 R:R; VWAP + 9/20 EMA + volume; exit by first 60-90 min
extracted_signals.gap: no pre-market gapper universe scanner with float + gap-percent + RV filter

extracted_signals.author: TradeOlogy Academy

extracted_signals.gap: verify retest-rejection candle close logic + volume confirmation present

extracted_signals.author: FlashAlpha
extracted_signals.rule_summary: 3 SPY GEX levels: call wall (peak positive call gamma = resistance), put wall (peak put gamma = support), gamma flip (net GEX crosses zero); positive-GEX regime = fade extremes; negative-GEX = trend continuation; wall break = do not fade
extracted_signals.gap: verify gex_scanner emits all 3 levels + regime tag; walls + flip distance not confirmed

extracted_signals.author: SpotGamma
extracted_signals.rule_summary: 5-min morning routine: (1) tag regime pos/neg gamma; (2) mark flip; (3) call wall + put wall; (4) check expiration weighting incl 0DTE share; (5) write 1-sentence thesis. 3 setups: call-wall fade, put-wall breakdown, zero-gamma-flip crossing (2-sided, 5-min hold past level on volume)
extracted_signals.gap: no zero-gamma-flip crossing shadow scanner; no 0DTE-specific GEX overlay

extracted_signals.author: GEXBoard
extracted_signals.rule_summary: 30-second refresh live gamma flip via price-level simulation (60 hypothetical levels, BS gamma recalc); proximity band alert; failed-reclaim short setup
extracted_signals.gap: no sub-minute flip refresh; no proximity-band alerting; no failed-reclaim shadow trade

extracted_signals.author: FlashAlpha
extracted_signals.rule_summary: Settled GEX (morning OI snapshot) reliable first 90 min; flow-GEX (settled + intraday flow simulator, side-classified buy/sell) required after 11am ET; 15-25% of near-term OI turns over intraday; walls can drift $2-5 by midday
extracted_signals.gap: gex_scanner uses static/settled OI; no flow-adjusted GEX after 11am

extracted_signals.author: Trader Central
extracted_signals.rule_summary: IV rises 10-20% above baseline 2-3 days pre-FOMC; do not add short-vega in final 48h; enter post-crush short-vega positions 3:15-3:30pm ET (AFTER Fed Chair press conf ends), not at 2pm; expected move SPX 0.5-1.5%
extracted_signals.gap: no time-gated post-2:30pm short-vega entry rule; no 48h pre-event no-add gate

extracted_signals.author: Oyamori
extracted_signals.rule_summary: Tier 1 = CPI/NFP/FOMC/PCE; check IVR gate: IVR<30 = buy premium (long straddle or directional), IVR>60 = sell premium (iron condor or credit spread); compare historical move vs implied — if historical exceeds implied by >=20% and IVR<30, straddle is underpriced
extracted_signals.gap: no composite tier + IVR + EM-ratio gate; no pre-event straddle/condor auto-selector

extracted_signals.author: Pure Power Picks
extracted_signals.rule_summary: 3-phase FOMC framework: (1) before = sell premium or buy early+small; (2) during (2:00-2:30) = avoid new long premium, expect whipsaw; (3) after (post-2:30 press conf) = trade clean directional trend with defined-risk debit spread

backlog_new_registry_entries.purpose: Shadow-replay 0.10-delta SPY 0DTE IC with $3 wings, VIX>14 gate, 25-35% credit floor, 2x credit stop, 2pm force-close
3pm ET GEX-derived pin price predictor + $1-wide 0DTE SPY butterfly at level; log delta between predicted pin and 4pm close
After 2:30pm FOMC press conf ends OR after 8:30am CPI/NFP resolves, enter defined-risk short-vega on SPY (iron condor at ±expected move); log IV-crush capture pct
5-min opening range 9:30-9:35 ET; first breakout only; ATM 0DTE call/put; -50%/+100% exit; 3:30 time stop; Mon/Wed/Fri filter
Per-symbol ORB with historical follow-through gate (NVDA/QQQ/SPY differentiated); pre-bell RV+relative-volume ranker
Signal flag when short-ORB base rate > long-ORB base rate over rolling N days (regime inversion detector)
Extend gex_scanner: after 11am ET, apply flow-adjusted OI (settled + side-classified intraday volume simulator); emit both settled and flow-adjusted flip + walls; alert when divergence > $2
Two-sided setup at zero-gamma level: breakout that holds 5min past level on volume = trend entry; return inside within 10min = fade entry
Pre-market universe filter: gap >= 4%, RV >= 100k pre-mkt, small float; feeds 1-min ORB shadow for gappers
Composite gate: Tier1_catalyst_next_3d AND (IVR<30 for buy_premium OR IVR>60 for sell_premium) AND historical_move/implied_move >= 1.2 for buy

summary.recommendation: Prioritize P1 entries: gex-pin-butterfly, flow-adjusted GEX, post-catalyst IV-crush, catalyst-composite-gate, SPY 0DTE IC challenger. All shadow-only; require 5+ session recall proof before promotion consideration.
